title: Checkout A/B right-skewed latency comparison
what: median latency saving (ms or %), or the two medians

reader_questions.question: By how much did the new checkout flow change median latency (in ms or %)?
reader_questions.expected: Median latency fell by ~83.5 ms (~19.7%, from ~424 ms to ~341 ms).

reader_questions.question: What spread or tail information is shown across the 400 sessions per arm?
reader_questions.expected: Distribution spread (IQR / percentiles / tail points across 400 sessions per arm).

reader_questions.question: Why are medians emphasized over means?
reader_questions.expected: Checkout latencies are right-skewed with a long upper tail.
